name: alystria-studio
description: A local-first AI video tutorial generator.

scripts.test: node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs -r --if-present test && node scripts/run-python.mjs -m pytest services/pipeline/tests
scripts.test:unit: node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs -r --if-present test:unit && node scripts/run-python.mjs -m pytest services/pipeline/tests/unit
scripts.lint: node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs -r --if-present lint && node scripts/run-python.mjs -m ruff check services/pipeline
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs -r --if-present typecheck && node scripts/run-python.mjs -m mypy --strict services/pipeline/src
